name: figma-mcp-bridge
description: Figma MCP stdio and REPL frontends with local Figma MCP login support.

interface.shortDescription: Use Figma MCP over stdio or a stateful REPL proxy with local Figma MCP login.
interface.longDescription: Provides persistent figma-stdio and figma-repl-mcp MCP servers for the official Figma remote MCP endpoint, plus a local HTTP bridge used for Figma MCP login and credential caching.
